title: 洗手间所在楼层数
problem_statement_md:
假设一栋大楼在每五层的位置有洗手间。
例如，一栋12层的大楼在5楼和10楼都有洗手间。

写一个程序，楼层数作为输入，输出所有的洗手间所在楼层数。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Ranges[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A group of buildings have restrooms on every [b]5th[/b] floor.
For example, a building with 12 floors has restrooms on the 5th and 10th floors. 

Create a program that takes the total number of floors as input and outputs the floors that have restrooms.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
23

[b]Sample Output[/b]
5
10
15
20

[note]You can define a range with the corresponding rules and output the numbers in that range.
Remember, that [b]range(a, b)[/b] includes [b]a[/b], but does not include [b]b[/b].[/note]
hint_md:
你可以用相应的规则定义一个范围，并输出该范围内的数字。
记住，**range(a, b)** 包括 **a** ，但不包括 **b** 。

code_templates.solution_code:
n = int(input())
nums = list(range(5,n+1,5))
for x in nums:
	print (x)
